dialogues.jp: 音夢がいなくなった日。
dialogues.en: The day Nemu disappeared.
dialogues.text: The day Nemu disappeared.

dialogues.jp:
俺は親に言われて、かったりぃ、とずっと呟き
ながら適当に音夢を捜していた。
dialogues.en:
I was looking for Nemu. I was complaining "what a pain"
because my parents made me look for her.
dialogues.text:
I was looking for Nemu. I was complaining "what a pain"
because my parents made me look for her.

dialogues.jp:
かったりぃ、と呟きながら、夜になるまで音夢
を適当に捜していた。
dialogues.en:
I looked around carelessly complaining until it was dark
outside.
dialogues.text:
I looked around carelessly complaining until it was dark
outside.

dialogues.jp:
かったりぃ、と呟きながら、俺は足が靴擦れを
起こすまで適当に歩き回っていた。
dialogues.en:
I walked around until I had a blister on my foot from my
shoe.
dialogues.text:
I walked around until I had a blister on my foot from my
shoe.

dialogues.jp:
音夢を捜しに行った俺が、逆に警察に迷子とし
て家に連れ帰されたのは恥ずかしかった……。
dialogues.en:
I was mistaken for a lost child by the police instead of
Nemu and they took me home. That made me embarrassed.
dialogues.text:
I was mistaken for a lost child by the police instead of
Nemu and they took me home. That made me embarrassed.

dialogues.jp: そして次の日。
dialogues.en: The next day.
dialogues.text: The next day.

dialogues.jp: くそ忙しい中、俺はさくらに呼び出された。
dialogues.en: Sakura called me out even though I was really busy.
dialogues.text: Sakura called me out even though I was really busy.

dialogues.jp:
俺は音夢がいなくなったままでイライラしなが
ら、さくらと話をした。
dialogues.en:
I went to talk to Sakura, still frustrated by Nemu's
disappearance.
dialogues.text:
I went to talk to Sakura, still frustrated by Nemu's
disappearance.

dialogues.jp: 別れの話を……。
dialogues.en: And she told me goodbye.
dialogues.text: And she told me goodbye.

dialogues.jp:
両親の都合で海外に出かけることになったさく
らんぼ。
dialogues.en:
Sakura had to move to a foreign country because of her
parents.
dialogues.text:
Sakura had to move to a foreign country because of her
parents.

dialogues.jp: もう一度会える。
dialogues.en: We'll see each other again.
dialogues.text: We'll see each other again.

dialogues.jp: また会える。
dialogues.en: For sure.
dialogues.text: For sure.

dialogues.jp: 音夢がいなくなって――さくらもいなくなって。
dialogues.en: Nemu disappeared and then Sakura......
dialogues.text: Nemu disappeared and then Sakura......

dialogues.jp:
そんな寂しさからか、俺はひとつの約束を交わ
した。
dialogues.en: It made me really sad, and I made a promise.
dialogues.text: It made me really sad, and I made a promise.

dialogues.jp: そこは――。
dialogues.en: That was......
dialogues.text: That was......

dialogues.jp: 枯れない桜の下だった。
dialogues.en: Under the cherry blossom tree.
dialogues.text: Under the cherry blossom tree.

dialogues.en: "Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu?"

dialogues.jp:
さくらが居なくなった後、鈴の音を聞きつけた
幼い俺は木の裏側をひょっこり覗き見た。
dialogues.en:
After Sakura left, I heard the ring of a bell. I went to
look behind the tree.
dialogues.text:
After Sakura left, I heard the ring of a bell. I went to
look behind the tree.

dialogues.jp:
まさか、こんなところで音夢を見つけるとは思
わなかった。
dialogues.en: I didn't think I'd find Nemu there.
dialogues.text: I didn't think I'd find Nemu there.

dialogues.jp: 「お、おい音夢！？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Nemu?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「…………おはよう、お兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "............Good morning, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "............Good morning, oniichan."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いなくなったと思ったら、こんなところで寝
　てたのかお前！？」
dialogues.en: "Were you sleeping here? I thought you had disappeared."
dialogues.text: "Were you sleeping here? I thought you had disappeared."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「うん……気持ちいいでしょ？　春一番だよ、
　お兄ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Doesn't it feel good? It's spring time, oniichan."
dialogues.text: "Doesn't it feel good? It's spring time, oniichan."

dialogues.jp: 笑っていた。
dialogues.en: She was smiling.
dialogues.text: She was smiling.

dialogues.jp: すごく腹が立った。
dialogues.en: That made me upset.
dialogues.text: That made me upset.

dialogues.jp:
こいつは、こんなところで、こんな穏やかに座っ
ていたのだ……。
dialogues.en: She was sitting like this the whole time......
dialogues.text: She was sitting like this the whole time......

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「知ってる？　お兄ちゃん。この桜の木の下で
　約束すると、それは絶対に……絶対に叶うん
　だって」
dialogues.en:
"Did you know that if you make a promise under this tree
then it becomes true?"
dialogues.text:
"Did you know that if you make a promise under this tree
then it becomes true?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「どうして居なくなったんだよ……昨日からずっ
　とココに居たのか？」
dialogues.en: "Why did you disappear? Have you been here since yesterday?"
dialogues.text: "Why did you disappear? Have you been here since yesterday?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「キャンプ好きなのか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you like camping?"
dialogues.text: "Do you like camping?"

dialogues.jp: 歯をかみ締めて呟く。
dialogues.en: I mumbled, gritting my teeth.
dialogues.text: I mumbled, gritting my teeth.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「キャンプなんてしたことないけど、虫は嫌だ
　ね。あと、夜はザザザって音が怖いね」
dialogues.en:
"I've never camped before but I don't like bugs. And I'm
kind of scared of the noise the wind makes."
dialogues.text:
"I've never camped before but I don't like bugs. And I'm
kind of scared of the noise the wind makes."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「月でできた木の影が人に見えた……誰かが歩
　いてるみたいな音がした」
dialogues.en:
"The shadow of the tree looked like a person, and I heard a
noise sounded like someone walking."
dialogues.text:
"The shadow of the tree looked like a person, and I heard a
noise sounded like someone walking."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「遠くで犬が鳴いた……寂しそうだった……夜
　は寒かった……」
dialogues.en:
"And a dog was barking in the distance. He sounded sad. And
it was cold at night."
dialogues.text:
"And a dog was barking in the distance. He sounded sad. And
it was cold at night."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「怖かった……すごく怖かったよ」
dialogues.en: "It scared me. I was really scared."
dialogues.text: "It scared me. I was really scared."

dialogues.jp: 泣いていた。
dialogues.en: She was crying.
dialogues.text: She was crying.

dialogues.jp: 「なんで帰ってこなかったんだよ！！」
dialogues.en: "Why didn't you come home??"
dialogues.text: "Why didn't you come home??"

dialogues.jp: でも俺は怒った。
dialogues.en: I was mad.
dialogues.text: I was mad.

dialogues.jp:
「怖かったら俺を呼べばいいだろう！　寒かっ
　たら俺の布団まで戻って来れば良かっただろ
　う！」
dialogues.en:
"Why didn't you call me if you were scared? Why didn't you
come into my bed if you were cold?"
dialogues.text:
"Why didn't you call me if you were scared? Why didn't you
come into my bed if you were cold?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ごめんね……でも、私がいるとお兄ちゃんに
　迷惑をかけるから」
dialogues.en: "Sorry. But I didn't want to make trouble for you."
dialogues.text: "Sorry. But I didn't want to make trouble for you."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「おじさんも……おばさんも……お兄ちゃんの
　お父さんとお母さんなのに……」
dialogues.en: "It's your Dad and Mom......"
dialogues.text: "It's your Dad and Mom......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「お布団とかご飯とか……っく……みんな私が
　いるから半分になっちゃって」
dialogues.en: "You have to share your bed and meals because of me."
dialogues.text: "You have to share your bed and meals because of me."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「お兄ちゃんに迷惑ばっかりかけて……泣き虫
　で、私がいないほうがいいの……！」
dialogues.en:
"I'm making a lot of troubles for you. I'm such a crybaby I
shouldn't be here."
dialogues.text:
"I'm making a lot of troubles for you. I'm such a crybaby I
shouldn't be here."

dialogues.jp:
胸が痛くて、目が熱くて、どうしようもなく腹
が立った。
dialogues.en: My chest hurt, my eyes were hot, and I was really mad.
dialogues.text: My chest hurt, my eyes were hot, and I was really mad.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だから、私は――」
――パシッ！
dialogues.en: Slap!
dialogues.text: Slap!

dialogues.jp: 頬を、叩いた。
dialogues.en: I slapped her cheek.
dialogues.text: I slapped her cheek.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……心配……かけるなよバカ」
dialogues.en: "Don't you make me worry like this, idiot."
dialogues.text: "Don't you make me worry like this, idiot."

dialogues.jp: 叩いた手が痛いくらい、思いっきり叩いた。
dialogues.en: I slapped her so hard my hand hurt.
dialogues.text: I slapped her so hard my hand hurt.

dialogues.jp: その手を差し出した。
dialogues.en: And I reached that hand out to her.
dialogues.text: And I reached that hand out to her.

dialogues.jp: 「帰るぞ……お前の家に」
dialogues.en: "Let's go home. Your home."
dialogues.text: "Let's go home. Your home."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "My home?"
dialogues.text: "My home?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「俺達のか」
dialogues.en: "I should say our home."
dialogues.text: "I should say our home."

dialogues.jp:
音夢を立ち上がらせて、服の汚れをはたいてやっ
て、最後に叩いた頬をさすってやった。
dialogues.en:
I helped Nemu stand up, and cleaned her clothes, then I
rubbed her cheek where I slapped her.
dialogues.text:
I helped Nemu stand up, and cleaned her clothes, then I
rubbed her cheek where I slapped her.

dialogues.jp: 「バカ」
dialogues.en: "Idiot."
dialogues.text: "Idiot."

dialogues.jp: 涙がでていた。
dialogues.en: The tears came down from my eyes.
dialogues.text: The tears came down from my eyes.

dialogues.jp: 俺が泣いたのを見て、音夢も泣き出した。
dialogues.en: Nemu started to cry as she saw my tears.
dialogues.text: Nemu started to cry as she saw my tears.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「っく……う……ごめ、ごめんなさい……もう
　迷惑かけないから……強くなるから」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry. I won't do that again. I'll be strong."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry. I won't do that again. I'll be strong."

dialogues.jp: 抱きしめて背中を叩いてやった。
dialogues.en: I hugged her and patted her back.
dialogues.text: I hugged her and patted her back.

dialogues.jp:
少しだけ背の高い少女は、俺の首に手を回して
グズグズと泣いていた。
dialogues.en:
She was a little bit taller than me, and she placed her arms
around my neck and cried.
dialogues.text:
She was a little bit taller than me, and she placed her arms
around my neck and cried.

dialogues.jp:
俺は泣かないようにがんばったのに、どうして
も涙が止まらなかった。
dialogues.en: I tried not to cry but I couldn't help it.
dialogues.text: I tried not to cry but I couldn't help it.

dialogues.jp: 「バカ」
dialogues.en: "Idiot."
dialogues.text: "Idiot."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ごめん……ごめんなさい……わ、私……甘え
　ない……がんばる……」
dialogues.en:
"Sorry...... I'm sorry...... I'll try to be independent.
I'll try."
dialogues.text:
"Sorry...... I'm sorry...... I'll try to be independent.
I'll try."

dialogues.jp: 甘えろよ――そう言うには幼すぎた。
dialogues.en: I was too small to say "depend on me".
dialogues.text: I was too small to say "depend on me".

dialogues.jp: 守らなくてはいけないと思った。
dialogues.en: I decided I had to protect her.
dialogues.text: I decided I had to protect her.

dialogues.jp: なにがあろうとも。
dialogues.en: No matter what happens.
dialogues.text: No matter what happens.

dialogues.jp: 誰でもない。
dialogues.en: Nobody else.
dialogues.text: Nobody else.

dialogues.jp: 俺が、俺に誓った約束だから。
dialogues.en: It's a promise I made to myself.
dialogues.text: It's a promise I made to myself.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「もう……お兄ちゃんって呼ばないから……」
dialogues.en: "I won't call you oniichan anymore......"
dialogues.text: "I won't call you oniichan anymore......"

dialogues.jp: ◆兄さんになった日◆
dialogues.en: ◆The day I became 'niisan'◆
dialogues.text: ◆The day I became 'niisan'◆

dialogues.jp: 夢を見た。
dialogues.en: I dreamed.
dialogues.text: I dreamed.

dialogues.jp:
音夢がいなくなった日の夢を。そして、さくら
がいなくなる日、音夢を見つけたときの夢を。
dialogues.en:
A dream about the day Nemu disappeared. And the day I found
Nemu as Sakura left.
dialogues.text:
A dream about the day Nemu disappeared. And the day I found
Nemu as Sakura left.

dialogues.jp:
この時からだった。音夢が俺を“兄さん”と呼
ぶようになったのは。
dialogues.en:
That was when she stopped calling me oniichan, and started
to call me niisan.
dialogues.text:
That was when she stopped calling me oniichan, and started
to call me niisan.

dialogues.jp: 俺に頼らなくなったのは……。
dialogues.en: And she stopped depending on me......
dialogues.text: And she stopped depending on me......
